newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Minnesota crude unit remains down.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Minnesota crude unit remains down.

text.p: Ashland Inc said Monday the crude unit at its St. Paul Park, Minnesota refinery will not be back up as soon as expected after it was downed by a minor leak last Wednesday.
"They did find additional maintenance that needed to be taken care of, and we will try to have the crude unit back up in a couple of days," said a company spokesman.
The unit, one of two at the 69,000 barrel-per-day plant, was expected to be back on line by Friday or Saturday.

The company would not comment by how much production has been cut, but a source familiar with Ashland operations said the refinery is running at about 40,000 bpd, or at nearly 60 percent of the refinery's total crude distillation capacity.
